errors.name: CategoryNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a category with the given id or name is not found in the database.

errors.name: ProductNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a product with the given id is not found in the database.

errors.name: SkuAlreadyExistsError
errors.description: Raised when attempting to add a product with a sku that already exists.

errors.name: InvalidSkuError
errors.description: Raised when the sku is not a string.

errors.name: InvalidPriceError
errors.description: Raised when the price_cents is not an integer.

errors.name: InvalidStockQtyError
errors.description: Raised when the stock_qty is not a non-negative integer.

errors.name: InvalidThresholdError
errors.description: Raised when the reorder_threshold is not a positive integer.

errors.name: MissingRequiredFieldError
errors.description: Raised when a required field is missing during category or product creation.

errors.name: InvalidIdError
errors.description: Raised when an ID is not a valid integer.
